_about: Values used only to test schemas/sources.schema.json. The schema is a vocabulary, not a record (H-2; S06 builds the source record), so each fixture is one value rather than a record, and each invalid case is one value that must be rejected for the reason it names.

invalid.why: D-015's provisional tiers are not classes; a tier is a rank
MA §10's order is not stored as a number (no ranking, no score)
first-hand standing is a relation between a source and a claim (D-035), never a class
verification is the Verifier's act on a claim, not a property of the source
company sources are split by document kind; the publisher alone is not a class
near miss: the value is company_marketing
tertiary summaries and snippets are discovery aids with no class (source-policy.md §2)
a search result is never a source (D-014; source-policy.md §2)
an empty class is not a class; a missing class is never a default
unknown is not null; a source without a class is a gap to fix, not a value
one class per source; a joint report takes its publisher's class (source-policy.md §2)
